dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "People of the Springs! To commemorate our victory, I have decided to set aside a day of annual remembrance where we might come together and celebrate!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "It shall be a day when we thank the heroes who saved Natlan and ensure that their names live on for all time!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "I will invite Sadigua to tell stories of the heroes' mighty deeds, and so shall they be remembered!"
